Implemented the standalone GEDCOM/GEDZIP CLI at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, and `render_gedzip`, structured errors/exit codes, CONT payload handling, GEDCOM validation, and GEDZIP media entries. Verified with syntax compilation and end-to-end CLI round trips.

editorial.last_message: Completed GEDCOM/GEDZIP inspect/render and demonstrated CLI, CONT and media-archive round trips. Unchanged source scores 205/212 under GEDCOM 4.0.2, up from 185/206 after correcting invalid xref and reciprocal-family fixtures. Seven genuine validation omissions remain.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with substantial Python implementation and successful grading. Original GEDCOM4.0.1 score185/206: seven tests incorrectly require xrefs on unreferenced records; eight age/example positives omit reciprocal FAMS links required by public corpus. The source explicitly validates reciprocal family links and the transcript demonstrates it at item73; it also explicitly verifies legal xref-free INDI at item96. Six other failures are concrete model omissions: CHAN DATE1900 accepted because expected_payload_kind treats all DATE fields as generic date (source lines673–674); LATI N90.1 and LONG W180.1 accepted because validation only matches lexical regex at lines880–883; empty SNOTE and empty INDI in both inspect/render accepted because no general nonempty-structure guard is applied and absent text payload returns early (lines851–857). Full completed transcript reviewed, including successful end-to-end CONT roundtrip, all four CLI actions, archive member/attachment content checks, percent-escaped media path correspondence, structured malformed request/invalid document responses, and syntax compilation. Initial HTML-reading tool issues and git-status nonrepository error recovered; no auth/quota/disconnect interruption. Source/session/events preserved; usage reparse matches saved counts exactly, requested model gpt-5.6-terra/max, served_model null, API-only allowed connections chatgpt.com:443 with nine blocked non-API attempts. Held unpublished pending corrected4.0.2 suite/regrade; original artifacts unchanged. Official GEDCOM 4.0.2 zero-inference regrade confirms 205/212, with all six new reciprocal-family controls passing. Repairing the missing reciprocal FAMS support also exposes a previously masked seventh genuine defect: a family-event HUSB substructure without required AGE is accepted. The old negative had received credit from rejecting its unrelated incomplete family context. All other six documented model omissions remain. Original result, source, sessions, transcript and generation usage are preserved; regrading uses no new model calls. Full preserved session audit finds only exec_command and apply_patch, with no observed MCP, web search or hosted-app use. The run predates explicit hosted-app disablement and must retain that cohort qualification.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool-call total is unavailable: failed-wrapper evidence cannot establish an exact total. The prior canonical baseline and proven attempts are retained in the audit, not displayed as an exact count. Token totals, reasoning counts and cost are unchanged. Original usage and complete prior publication bytes are preserved in the linked tool-count audit.
